review.content_class_rationale: Rendered and viewed the single PDF page: the CARE Checklist of information to include when writing a case report, with items 1 to 13, a Reported on Line column of line numbers or N/A entries and a ticked Yes consent box. It is a manuscript reporting checklist, not clinical data.

estimated_counts.basis: machine page count of the PDF; the one page was rendered and viewed

review.notes: Reporting-guideline checklist for the manuscript; the line-reference column holds line numbers and N/A entries and no patient clinical values. The ticked consent box is administrative and is not recorded as a clinical fact.
limitations: Single rendered page viewed at full resolution; line-number entries and the consent tick were read as printed and are not transcribed as clinical data.
Machine draft: every review block must be completed by a reviewer who inspected the content.
